why: v1 debt, outside CS-FIN-001. All 37 items were raised by the backend and frontend implementations against FIN v1 (recurring templates, allocation rules, year-end close, SoD permissions, search filters, document numbering, api-docs location) and none of them is work this change set undertakes. The single item touching the v2 surface, API-FIN-020 request body shape, is answered by this version: ADR-FIN-031 names each business fact by its FIN_EVENT_BUSINESS_FIELD code as a key of the request fields map, and the rules engine reads a business field only through that code. The remaining items stay OPEN against v1 and are to be scheduled as their own FIN change set.
